title: Late Arrivals
statement: A list of arrival times, in minutes past the hour, is already in the file. Fill in `count_late` so it returns how many of them are after minute 5, and `main` prints that number.

files.name: late_arrivals.py

rubric: Only times after minute 5 are counted, so the 5 in the sample data is not late.
The answer is a number, returned from the function rather than printed inside it.
The count is right for the sample data: 9 and 17 are late, so it is 2.
The sample data and main are left as they are.
A loop and a counter are enough - nothing here needs a dictionary, sorting or slicing.
curveballs: Actually, count minute 5 as late too.
Now count the ones that were on time instead.
Only count the ones after minute 10.
